notes.title: 1.2.1 BUG FIX
notes.content: Fixed the crashing bug in last update, was a stupid typo I'm so sorry.

- Added an upper limit to player knock back. (Never really though someone would play to such high levels)
- Level 1 Damage Reduction is now a universal skill.

notes.title: v1.2 icons added
notes.content:
Added icons for the new upgrades added in 1.2.
Thanks @Kellon! for the art.

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
New Weapon:
- Shotgun: fire several bullets at a time

New upgrades:
shotgun:
- Less Spread: make your shotgun more accurate.
- More Bullets: fire even more bullets
sword:
- Damage Reduction: reduce damage taken.

Rebalance:
- Big Sword duration from 3s to 2s.
- Speed limit from 5 to 8 in fullscreen mode

Random Stuffs:
- The new updates have no icons yet, as I suddenly decided to make an update at 2am in the morning local time without informing anyone.
- There might be bugs, please report them.
- There might be future updates at random times, but truth to be told I'm really stressed recently so do not expect any regular updates.
- I also fixed the minor typo in the description of the gun.

notes.title: Minor bug fix & sound effect change
notes.content:
Fixed bug that fireball and ice storm might not explode in collision with the wall in windowed mode. Also should fixed some bug with sword wind but I couldn't find the difference.

Changed the sound effect of being hit.


There might be some new weapons coming soon but I'm not sure when I'll start working on it. I've been quite stressed recently and it's a bit hard to work on the game.

notes.title: Version 1.1 bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed the bug that when entered small screen mode and start playing, the level keeps growing and the game becomes unplayable.

Also fixed some minor invisible bug in settings.






The first bug was caused by an update of gamemaker studio earlier today which changed the ordering of rooms, it was really unexpected.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: - Fixed the bug causing crash when using sword wind

notes.title: Another Bug Fix
notes.content:
- Fixed a small bug that might prevent the "Speed up" upgrade from working.

BTW There are also some structure changes, please let me know if you encounter any bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.02 bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed the bug that the skill increasing sword wind frequency not actually appearing in the game.

Thanks to @DarkSoulBG for pointing it out.

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.content:
- Fixed bug that upgrade "More Choices" is not displayed on the pause screen

- Now player can only fire one sword wind per second

- Added upgrade that enables the player to fire sword wind more frequently

- Now the guide and settings menu can be accessed from p

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.content:
- Cool down time for Fire ball and Ice storm reduced from 10 seconds to 8 seconds
- Perk "Killing reduces cool down" does not work when the enemies is killed during time stop
